messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT detected: continuous-batching path p99 spike in us-west-2. Metric alert: contbatch_p99_latency > 600ms for 3m. Paging eng-oncall.
Maya R.: ack, looking. seeing p95 ~200ms but p99 around 900-1.2s on streaming route. Any customer-visible errors?
Luis (CS): Partner-X reported intermittent streaming stalls in their production logs ~09:07-09:13 UTC, looks correlated.
Ashwin P.: I'm on-call, grabbing screens. Can someone grab recent scheduler metrics and queue depth? suspect mixed sequence lengths + large max_batch.
Samir K.: pulling qp metrics now. queue_depth spikes on batcher-6 and batcher-9. KV cache miss rate up 12%. Looks like a handful of very long seq requests blocking fill.
Maya R.: logs excerpt:
```
[2025-07-14T09:08:12Z] batcher-6: enqueued=78 draining=2 batch_len=128 avg_seq=4096
[2025-07-14T09:08:12Z] batcher-6: processing_time=874ms kv_miss=0.11 streams_wait=0.23
[2025-07-14T09:08:13Z] scheduler: preempt_attempts=0 fairness_score=0.21
```
Maya R.: gate: we recently bumped max_batch_size to 128 for throughput. that plus a small fraction of 8k token requests is killing tail.
Ashwin P.: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily reduce contbatch max_batch_size to 32 for streaming routes in us-west-2, 2) enable preemptive-shedding on long seqs, 3) route streaming to dedicated low-latency pool if capacity allows. Who can flip the flag?
Samir K.: I'll flip the feature-flag for us-west-2 streaming lanes. command:
```
redwoodctl feature-flag set contbatch.streaming.max_batch_size us-west-2 32 --reason "live mitigation p99 spike"
```
Samir K.: also enabling preempt: `redwoodctl runtime set preemptive_shedding true --zone us-west-2`
Maya R.: doing quick canary: apply to one AZ first (us-west-2a) and observe p99. If good, roll to 2b/2c.
Ashwin P.: @Samir go ahead on 2a then wait 90s and post p95/p99. I'll notify CS and customers.
Samir K.: flipped flag in 2a at 09:10:06Z. preemptive_shedding toggled at 09:10:20Z.
ops-bot: Deploy hook: feature-flag update applied to runtime-group us-west-2a (change_id: ff-98324). Monitoring for 5m.
Maya R.: immediate effect: p99 dropped from ~1.1s -> 420ms on contbatch-streaming in 2a. p95 stable. queue_depth on batcher-6 fell from 78 -> 18.
Luis (CS): sending note to Partner-X: "We're aware and have applied mitigations; you're seeing reduced stalls". They asked about root cause and ETA for full rollback.
Ashwin P.: next steps: - extend change to 2b/2c if p99 holds for 3m - start a targeted rollback for recent max_batch_size config change (history shows an increase 2 days ago) - create postmortem tracking ticket and schedule deeper KV/cache analysis
Maya R.: request to ops: please keep preemptive_shedding on until we validate quantization/kv-cache behavior with mixed seqs. Also add temporary alert to fire at p99>400ms for streaming route.
Samir K.: will roll to 2b at 09:13:10Z, 2c queued after 30s. roll complete 09:14:05Z.
ops-bot: Alert muted for contbatch_p99_latency in us-west-2 during mitigation window (mute_id: mute-4421) by Ashwin P.
Maya R.: results after full roll: global p99 for contbatch-streaming us-west-2 = 380-460ms, p95 = 160-230ms. KV miss rate normalized to baseline ~3% after shedding.
Ashwin P.: customer impact assessment: small number of large-token streams caused disproportionate tail. Impacted sessions ~0.6% of total streaming requests but affected Partner-X's heavy streamers. No data loss, no error codes returned; just increased stalls. CS notified and has mitigation guidance.
Samir K.: follow-ups I'm ticketing: 1) autoshed threshold tuning for mixed seq(length) workloads, 2) scheduler fairness improvement (fairshare weight for streaming vs batch), 3) improve metrics to split by seq-length buckets, 4) e2e test with synthetic long seqs.
Maya R.: assign owners: Samir -> ticket scheduler/fairness, Ashwin -> feature-flag/rollback root cause, Ops -> add seq-length bucket metrics, Luis -> customer comms thread.
oncall-rotation: Ashwin taking on-call handoff; Maya will pair for the postmortem. logging handover: full trace + dashboard links in #incidents.
Ashwin P.: marking incident as mitigated at 09:16:00Z. I'll keep preemptive_shedding enabled for 1h then revisit. Will open a postmortem doc and link to this thread.
Luis (CS): partner updated and appreciative of quick response. asked for ETA on permanent fix, we said Q3 sprint cycle for scheduler work.
Maya R.: notes for postmortem: include reproducer script, perf delta for max_batch_size 32/64/128, and regression window for change that bumped to 128. Also check model variants that amplify kv misses.
Samir K.: grabbing traces to attach. here's sample span id: span_0x9f3a, will add logs.
ops-bot: Incident MITIGATED by Ashwin P. at 1762500360. Creating incident record IR-2025-1762500000.
Maya R.: thanks team. we'll keep this in watch for next 2 hours. if anyone sees p99 > 500ms re-alert here.
